interface.name: gnoblin_window_frame_manager_v1
interface.description: Advertised only on compositor-provisioned renderer connections. One renderer handles many frames. It cannot choose or claim target windows. This experimental v1 protocol is not yet a stable public ABI.

interface.name: gnoblin_window_frame_v1
interface.description: Attach an unroled wl_surface. Configure serials describe committed native geometry; ack the latest serial before committing a matching-size buffer. Stale generations are not displayed. App commits never wait for renderers. Normal wl_surface damage, buffer release, transforms and scale apply. Native code clips pixels and semantic input to the decoration area. Input is handled natively; this surface never receives keyboard focus. Metadata changes send a new configure. A null buffer selects fallback. After closed, only destroy is meaningful. Destroy the frame before its wl_surface. The surface cannot acquire a different role afterwards.

entry.name: role
entry.summary: surface already has a role or frame already attached

request.name: region
request.description: Double buffered with wl_surface.commit. At most 64 regions. Last registered wins overlaps. Coordinates are logical frame coordinates; regions cannot receive input in client content or outside the frame. Native fallback controls are used until a valid renderer buffer arrives.
